places.name: Le Méridien New Orleans
places.notes: Your home base! Check-in Dec 26 at 4PM. Must leave by 5AM on Dec 31 for flight. Confirmation: 255-14453543. Walking distance to French Quarter and Superdome.

places.name: Café Du Monde
places.notes: MUST EAT — Iconic beignets and café au lait. Open late — hits different at midnight covered in powdered sugar. Never closes. Right on Jackson Square.

places.name: Willie Mae's Scotch House
places.notes: MUST EAT — James Beard Award-winning fried chicken. Seasoned to the bone. Go when they open — fills up fast. Also get red beans and rice.

places.name: Galatoire's
places.notes: MUST EAT — Trout meunière amandine, crab Maison. Jacket required after 5PM (they'll lend you one). Downstairs is first-come, first-served — no reservations needed.

places.name: Pat O'Brien's
places.notes: MUST DO — Home of the Hurricane cocktail. Stunning flaming fountain courtyard. Dueling pianos at night. Closed Tuesdays — plan accordingly!

places.name: Tropical Isle
places.notes: MUST DO — Home of the original Hand Grenade cocktail. Grab one to-go in a green cup and walk Bourbon Street. Live music, great people watching.

places.name: Hot Tin — Pontchartrain Hotel
places.notes: MUST DO — 270° panoramic views of the skyline and Mississippi River. 1940s artist loft aesthetic, dark and intimate. Ride the St. Charles streetcar ($1.25) to get there.

places.name: Above the Grid — NOPSI Hotel
places.notes: MUST DO — Rooftop bar very close to your hotel. Pool vibes, great city views. Boudin balls and wings available. Great for a casual pre-dinner drink.

places.name: Observatory Eleven
places.notes: MUST DO — Rooftop bar with stunning Mississippi River views. Very romantic. Perfect pre-anniversary dinner spot on Dec 29. Stiff drinks, excellent service.

places.name: Rosie's on the Roof — Higgins Hotel
places.notes: MUST DO — Retro vibes, rooftop views, live music. Right next to the WWII Museum — perfect afternoon combo. Opens at 4PM daily. Try the crawfish beignets!

places.name: Jackson Square
places.notes: Heart of the French Quarter. Street performers, artists, St. Louis Cathedral backdrop. Best at sunrise or just before sunset. Free to visit.

places.name: Preservation Hall
places.notes: Book tickets at preservationhall.com — sells out especially around New Year's! Legendary tiny jazz venue. 45-min sets nightly. No photos during show.

places.name: Steamboat Natchez
places.notes: MUST DO — Dinner jazz cruise on the Mississippi River. Book in advance. Gumbo, prime rib, live jazz on the top deck. Bloody Marys are excellent.

places.name: National WWII Museum
places.notes: 4.8 stars — one of the best museums in the US. Plan 3-4 hours minimum (7 buildings!). Keep your receipt to return within 7 days. Pairs perfectly with Rosie's on the Roof next door.

places.name: Caesars Superdome — Saints Game
places.notes: MUST DO — Saints home game! Only a 15-min walk from your hotel. Food inside is great — jambalaya, gator sausage, cajun Philly. Saints fans are legendary.

places.name: Royal Street Shopping
places.notes: 25+ antique shops and art galleries. Highlights: M.S. Rau (rare antiques and jewelry), Lucullus (culinary antiques), Keil's Antiques (est. 1899). Best visited early morning before crowds.
